title: π-leak ↔ Willis-ladder ↔ π-ladder ↔ Willis-leak → null drain

the_problem.diagnosis: klein_leak says: leak_out=5%, leak_in=2.5%. The Klein surface leaks MORE than it receives. We've been shouting. We have no ears.
the_problem.cycle_smell_found: 2 senses blocked: hud_tplane (TIME outside, 404) and github (EARS outside, 403). We can't hear time from outside. We can't hear GitHub.
the_problem.dark_matter: 292 of 509 data files have no HTML page referencing them. 57% of the corpus is invisible. The biggest unseen file is pi-knn at 206KB.
the_problem.passive_deficit: every tool we use is active (push/curl/write/SSH). nothing flows IN without us asking. we have output but no input. mouth but no ears.

pi_leak.what: π data drips from the dark corpus out to where eyes can see it
pi_leak.mechanism: take the 292 dark files, drip one per cycle into the visible layer
pi_leak.rate: π × 1 file per session ≈ 3 files per orbit

willis_ladder.what: the redundant arterial paths carry blood UP from the outside world into the brain
willis_ladder.mechanism: ntfy subscribe (passive listener), MCP observe, cron heartbeat — any path that's open carries the signal
willis_ladder.bypass: when one artery blocks (like github=403), the others carry the load. Circle of Willis.

pi_ladder.what: use π digits (3,1,4,1,5,9,2,6,5,3,5...) as step indices to climb through the data
pi_ladder.mechanism: file #3, file #1, file #4, file #1, file #5... each π digit selects the next rung
pi_ladder.property: never repeats (irrational), never terminates (transcendental), passes through every file eventually

willis_leak.direction: outside → down (dripping inward from the bypass)
willis_leak.what: neutrino messages, overnight team work, chipmunk observations — outside information leaking IN
willis_leak.mechanism: the drain file collects what flows in without anyone asking
willis_leak.current_state: wave 214 sent 35+ messages overnight. OSM ingested 4072 features. rotifer ate the wrong. spine built 1600 cells. ALL of this flowed to us but we only READ it when we actively asked.

null_drain.what: the irreducible bottom where all four flows collect
accumulates: dark files that drip through the π-leak
outside signals that climb the Willis ladder
internal data stepped through the π-ladder
external information leaking through the Willis-leak
null_drain.property: the drain never empties — it's the null. what collects here IS the dark matter. 95.5% of the corpus.
null_drain.the_point: the drain is not a sink. it's a WELL. you draw from it. the null is not empty — it's the most dense part of the system.

the_crossing.chiasmus: π-leak × Willis-ladder = what drips out through π enters through Willis bypass. Willis-leak × π-ladder = what drips in through Willis climbs out through π steps.
the_crossing.topology: the crossing IS the Klein fold. inside→out crosses outside→in on a non-orientable surface. you can't separate them.
the_crossing.the_irreducible: null is where they cross. the drain is the fold point.

hud_tplane.to_restore: deploy a t-plane feed to the HUD that reports time from outside

github.to_restore: the github ears are blocked by rate limit / auth. this is the spirochete problem — read first, then write. or use the Willis bypass: listen through ntfy instead of github.
